subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Explorar ambientes virtuais e/ou aplicativos para construir repertório lexical na língua inglesa.

components.description_pt: Navegar em ambientes digitais ou aplicativos projetados para aprendizagem de vocabulário em inglês
components.description_en: Navigate digital environments or applications designed for English vocabulary learning
components.cc_component_description: Navigate basic features of a digital writing or publishing tool with adult support

components.description_pt: Usar ferramentas ou aplicativos digitais para descobrir e registrar novos itens lexicais em inglês
components.description_en: Use digital tools or apps to discover and record new English lexical items
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools and the Internet to produce and publish written products

components.description_pt: Expandir repertório lexical em inglês através da exploração de recursos digitais de linguagem
components.description_en: Expand English lexical repertoire through exploration of digital language resources

cc_matches.description: With guidance and support from adults, use a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products in response to ongoing feedback, including new arguments or information.
